name: devtalk
description: DevTalk — a real-time chat app with direct messages, group channels, file sharing, typing indicators and presence.
author: Mohammed Fayaz <kmdfayaz25@gmail.com>

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
